name: How much does it cost to fix a gurgling drain?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to fix a gurgling drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to fix a gurgling drain varies widely depending on the underlying cause and severity. A simple drain snaking for a localized clog might range from $150 to $300. If the problem involves a main sewer line blockage or a vent pipe issue, costs can be higher, potentially ranging from $300 to $600 or more, especially if specialized equipment like a sewer camera inspection or hydro-jetting is required. We provide upfront estimates after diagnosing the specific issue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on the issue; a simple clog might be $150-$300, while main line or vent problems could be $300-$600+.
